properties.name: Clearwater Palisades
properties.vantage_description: Western Clearwater Lake and the lodge waterfront, looking east; paddle toward the first cliff.
properties.evidence: The lodge describes two tall basalt cliffs dominating the eastward view from its waterfront and a paddle to the first cliff base.
properties.coordinate_basis: Published GPS is the landing WEST of the cliff. This is an anchor for a broad landmark region, not the cliff summit or face.
properties.uncertainty: Do not use this coordinate as a precise target for a bearing or viewshed. The source describes two cliffs; record intentionally groups them.

properties.name: Winchell cliffs
properties.vantage_description: Winchell Lake water north of the southern-shore cliffs; the field account explicitly describes looking at the cliffs from the water.
properties.evidence: First-person discussion and photographs document viewing the cliffs from water and a canoe landing to their west.
properties.coordinate_basis: Published approximate point of interest named Cliffs of Winchell lake.
properties.uncertainty: Community waypoint, not surveyed. Trail directions conflict across older accounts; no hiking route is asserted here.

properties.name: Rose Lake cliffs
properties.vantage_description: Rose Lake western arm and the approach from Rat Lake; cliffs also appear eastward from western South Lake.
properties.evidence: Field guide describes tall shoreline cliffs and the scenic paddle through the long western arm. A canoe-trip photograph independently documents Rose cliffs eastward from South Lake.
properties.coordinate_basis: Published Rose Lake Cliffs overlook coordinate, used to anchor a broad cliff region.
properties.uncertainty: Overlook coordinate is not a surveyed cliff face. Visibility is regional, not an all-lake or all-direction claim.

properties.name: Brule rockslide
properties.vantage_description: Western Brule Lake bay beside the Wench portage; photographed from the lake at the published Brule Rockslide photo point.
properties.evidence: The paddler describes crossing to the rockslide, the striking escarpment, and landing beneath its cliffs at the Wench portage.
properties.coordinate_basis: Published View from Brule Rockslide photo coordinate; the same album locates the on-water Brule Rockslide photo nearby.
properties.uncertainty: Photo geotags are not surveyed feature geometry; approximate region only.
properties.vantage_coordinate_basis: Published photo geotag titled Brule Rockslide, 2015-07-10.

properties.name: Seagull Palisades
properties.vantage_description: North side of Seagull Lake beside Miles Island; canoe past the cliff face.
properties.evidence: Outfitter explicitly describes canoeing past the palisades before stopping for a hike.
properties.coordinate_basis: Outfitter publishes Seagull Palisades waypoint N 48 degrees 08.498 minutes, W 090 degrees 55.297 minutes; converted to decimal degrees.
properties.uncertainty: Waypoint may identify top rather than exposed face; lake visibility supported but no exact bearing validated.

properties.name: Rose Falls / Stairway Falls
properties.vantage_description: Walk from the Duncan–Rose Stairway Portage landing; viewpoint is on land beside the falls.
properties.evidence: The lodge instructs visitors to leave the canoe at the landing and walk to the falls.
properties.coordinate_basis: OpenStreetMap waterfall node 5883313942 coordinates as published by Mapcarta.
properties.uncertainty: Waterfall access is documented; no claim of seeing the falls from a canoe. Falls and trail viewpoints are different locations.

properties.name: Johnson Falls
properties.vantage_description: Trail at far western Pine Lake, reached after the Little Caribou–Pine carry; about a quarter-mile walk to the falls.
properties.evidence: Outfitter describes a quarter-mile hike from the west end of Pine to the two-tier falls.
properties.coordinate_basis: Published approximate Lower Johnson Falls waypoint; this record groups both tiers.
properties.uncertainty: Community point is approximate and marks lower falls. The source website miscategorizes it as Pictographs; that category is not adopted.

properties.name: Saganaga Falls
properties.vantage_description: Beside the final Granite River–Saganaga carry; use the portage-side area as the viewing region.
properties.evidence: Outfitter describes arrival at Saganaga Falls and the 34-rod portage around them before entering Saganaga.
properties.coordinate_basis: Canadian Geographical Names Database official feature FCNHV, published 48.22851,-90.83971, with 100 m location descriptor; corroborated by GNIS/OSM-derived waterfall point 48.2286,-90.8398.
properties.uncertainty: Conservatively classified as a portage stop; no safe open-water viewing position asserted. A separate GeoNames-derived Mapcarta point lies hundreds of metres northeast and was rejected.
